degree_rationale: Why the man of heaven looks down toward water and finds his face turned downward — symbol of the Calling watching downward to the cosmos; the man rising from water as the Answer; cattle and trees hanging in water as souls hung to zodiac; the shadow upon earth as body coming out of Deep. Treats natural mirror-phenomena as inner mysteries.
direction_rationale: Inward processing of mirror-correspondences — the human contemplative reception of cosmic mysteries through natural reflection.
grand_man_function: Natural reflection-reception — the contemplative reading of mirror-mysteries.
title: Why the man of heaven looks down toward earth, like a deer to water
